is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.s. from M'Bé, Côte d'Ivoire (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions an allelic frequency of L1014F (L104F) kdr mutation of around 80% on Page 3, but this is cited from previous literature (references 7 and 17) as background for the study site; no target markers were genotyped in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype data or counts were generated or reported in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild Anopheles gambiae s.s. were evaluated in experimental huts in M'Bé, Côte d'Ivoire (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical semi-field experimental hut trial and bioassay evaluation.

sub_country_location.evidence: M'Bé area, 30 km north of Bouaké (5.209963 W, 7.970241 N), Côte d'Ivoire (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The exact collection dates/years for the experimental hut trial are not explicitly stated in the text.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary semi-field experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: No missing supplementary marker genotype data.

assessment.summary: This paper reports a Phase II semi-field experimental hut trial and CDC bottle/WHO cone bioassays evaluating Interceptor G2 (alphacypermethrin + chlorfenapyr) against wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.s. in M'Bé, Côte d'Ivoire. No insecticide resistance marker genotyping was performed in this study; kdr mutation frequency is only mentioned as background context cited from prior literature.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide resistance markers (L1014F mentioned is cited from prior background literature).
Does not report extractable genotype data.
